notes: Bhishma Parva opening. Krishna charioteer + teacher. Vishvarupa tasteful comic radiance not horror. No gore battle focus — sacred teaching on the field.

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, optional peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar dhoti, garland, charioteer posture

arjuna.face: Noble young warrior prince, expressive eyes (grief then resolve)
arjuna.hair: Dark hair, warrior topknot / crown optional
arjuna.costume: White and gold armor accents, bow Gandiva

armies.costume: Muted army ranks, banners — equal human scale

chariot.costume: White horses, ornate Pandava chariot with Krishna as driver
